This three-bedroom, two-bathroom family home at 9 Blackberry Pl, Palm Coast, sits on a quiet residential street. Three bedrooms give a room each for a family of three children or a study and a playroom as needs change, and two bathrooms take the pressure off busy school-run mornings.

The open-plan living area keeps the family in one space through the day, with room for homework at one end and dinner at the other. The attached two-car garage gives generous storage for bikes, scooters and everything else a growing household collects.

Weekends spread outdoors. The screened lanai is a place for breakfast and quiet evenings, and the mature garden gives children space to play. Schools, the intracoastal waterway and local amenities are all close by.

It is a settled, calm home with room to grow, one a family grows into, not out of in three years.

Dom dla rodziny przy 9 Blackberry Pl w Palm Coast na Florydzie: trzy sypialnie i dwie łazienki w domu jednorodzinnym przy cichej ulicy. Trzy sypialnie dają miejsce na codzienny rytm całej rodziny, a przy dwóch łazienkach poranki przed szkołą przebiegają spokojniej, bo nikt nie czeka w kolejce. Ten sam układ można zaplanować na kilka sposobów: pokój dla każdego, a gdy sytuacja się zmieni, jeden z pokoi może służyć za gabinet albo miejsce do odrabiania lekcji.

Część dzienna ma otwarty układ, więc wszyscy są w zasięgu wzroku: ktoś gotuje, ktoś pracuje przy stole, dzieci bawią się obok. Dwustanowiskowy garaż przylegający do domu to miejsce na samochody, rowery i wszystko, co zwykle zbiera się w rodzinnym domu. Weekendy można spędzać na zadaszonym tarasie z moskitierą (lanai) albo w dojrzałym ogrodzie.

Dom stoi w pobliżu szkół, wód śródlądowych (intracoastal waterway) i lokalnych punktów usługowych, co ułatwia codzienne sprawy. To dom, w który rodzina wrasta, zamiast z niego wyrastać: układ, ogród i spokojna ulica sprawdzają się na kolejnych etapach dorastania dzieci. Cena: 385000 USD.

A two-bedroom flat in Krakow's Podgorze district, and a manageable next step from renting. The asking price is 949,000 PLN, and the costs around it are clear: service charges are 610 PLN per month, including water and building insurance. One parking space in the gated underground garage and a storage unit in the basement are included in the price, so there are fewer extras to budget for later. The title is full freehold, with a land and mortgage register.

The flat measures 64 sqm and sits on the third floor of a 2019 building. The south-facing living room has an open kitchen with built-in appliances, and the kitchen furniture and appliances stay with the sale. Two separate bedrooms give you room to settle in. The bathroom has a walk-in shower and underfloor heating, and there is a separate WC. Floors are oak and the windows are triple-glazed. A 7 sqm balcony runs along the living room and overlooks a landscaped inner courtyard.

The building has a lift, a bicycle room and a video intercom. The Vistula boulevards and the Kladka Bernatka footbridge are a short walk away. Trams to the Old Town and Kazimierz stop 300 metres from the entrance, and the neighbourhood has shops, cafes and a primary school.

One thing to know up front: the flat is currently let on a fixed-term lease that ends in June 2027, at a monthly rent of 4,200 PLN. Viewings are by appointment through the agency, and the tenant asks for 24 hours notice. It is a place you could picture waking up in, with a balcony to have your morning coffee on and a home that is yours.
